title: Amphihexahedral
summary: AMPHIHEXAHE'DRAL, adjective [Gr. and hexahedral.] In crystallography, when the faces of the crystal, counted in two different directions, give two hexahedral outlines, or are found to be six in number

inlines.v: AMPHIHEXAHE'DRAL, adjective [Gr. and hexahedral.] In crystallography, when the faces of the crystal, counted in two different directions, give two hexahedral outlines, or are found to be six in number.
